trailhead.label: Pozza di Fassa (Piaza de Comun), the APT’s start

cautions: Gravel tracks shared with farm vehicles near Masc Aloch.
Working farm with animals at Masc Aloch.
In winter the Aloch slope is a ski area; this is a summer walk.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
